Bug_Details:
A class can be annotated with at most one scope annotation. Annotating a class with more than one scope annotation is invalid according to
the JSR-330 specification.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by annotating the class with two scope annotations, which is invalid according to the JSR-330 specification.

Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method of the InjectMoreThanOneScopeAnnotationOnClass class, which is annotated with two scope annotations (Singleton and AnotherScope). This violates the JSR-330 specification, which states that a class can only be annotated with a single scope annotation.
